title: Fix sendEvent crash — add try/catch to WebSocket send in adapter
description: P0 from 10-agent audit (escalated by council). sendEvent() in MineflayerAdapter/index.js ~122 has no try/catch around agentSocket.send(). A transient WebSocket error during any event handler (move, health, death, etc.) terminates the Node.js process. Wrap send() in try/catch with structured logging. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md (P0-002).
